contexts.text: Suction on the top of the head.
The crown of the head of the Nazarite () = exterior things. AC 6437:end, Explained. AE 448:6. AE 577:6.
The Lord does not appear... in the zenith.
On those who appear almost over the top of the head.
The crown of the head of the chosen of his brethren () = the Spiritual which inflows into all the truths and goods of that Church.
The crown of the head which shall be made bald () = the intelligence of which this Church will be deprived.
The crown of the head of the Nazarite of his brethren () = the intelligence and knowledge which are of the external man.
To sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains () = worship from the love of self.
The crown of the head, in sacrifices () = internal truths.
The top of Carmel () = the truths of the Church, because in Carmel there were vineyards...
The greater part of those who look to the Father look to the zenith of Heaven, whence there is no turning.
